description: Interactive truth-table explorer for CNOT, CZ, SWAP, and Toffoli gates. Users select a gate and click rows in the complete input-to-output truth table. The right panel shows the circuit diagram, gate description, and key algebraic properties. CZ phase flip is explicitly labeled. Toffoli uses 3 qubits (8 rows).

learningObjectives: Explain how CNOT, CZ, SWAP, and Toffoli transform basis states
Predict gate output from a given computational basis input
